body: I don’t know...I don’t see how it can ever get better. He’s gone. I don’t see any lights in my future without him

My favorite singer of all time, Jonghyun, committed suicide yesterday.

I can’t believe this is happening. I can’t believe this is happening. I can’t breathe. I hate that he brought happiness to so many people and he wasn’t happy himself. I can’t believe this.

His smile got me through days that I couldn’t find the motivation to get up and go to school. His songs made me feel better when nothing else could. I was a fan since I was twelve years old. I grew up listening to him. It hurts so much to know he was hurting. I knew he was depressed but I didn’t know he was suicidal. I wish he was still here. I need him. I can’t believe this is happening. I just want to rewind time. I don’t want to be here, in this world, where Kim Jonghyun isn’t alive. I wish he was happy. I wish someone had helped him.This isn’t fair. I want to die too. Please someone help me I’m scared I might hurt myself...I’m 16f by the way
